relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: However, analysis of tail vasodilatations as a surrogate for motion-induced nausea was robust for both migraine triggers.

key_findings: Only the CGRP receptor antagonist olcegepant, not triptans, rescued motion-induced tail vasodilatation in CGRP/SNP mouse migraine models.
